one_liner: Access Ahrefs marketing and search data through comprehensive APIs and developer tools.
auth_notes: Ahrefs Connect uses OAuth 2.0 for user integrations, and API keys are available for management.
access_notes: API and MCP access require an Ahrefs paid subscription plan.
api_notes: REST API v3 covering Site Explorer, Keywords Explorer, Rank Tracker, Site Audit, and more.
blocker_notes: Requires a paid Ahrefs plan and approval/review for the Ahrefs Connect integration program.

auth.quote: Users connect their Ahrefs account via OAuth, and your app can fetch data using their API units.

api.quote: Ahrefs API v3 lets you pull a wide range of data, including: - Organic and backlinks data from Site Explorer

mcp.quote: Ahrefs now has an official MCP server that connects directly to Claude and ChatGPT.

verdict.quote: Once a technology provider joins the Ahrefs Connect Program, their integration becomes available to users on Ahrefs paid plans
